_about: LGBTQIA+ friendliness reviews found through web research on the most common businesses in the Heatmap's business sweep. Every review links to its source. scope "brand" means the source speaks about a chain as a whole; scope "location" means it speaks about one specific place. A search that turned up nothing is listed under researched, not stored as a review: an unreviewed business is unrated, not unfriendly.
_method: The 28 business names that appear 3 or more times in the saved sweep were each searched twice, once for Orlando reports and once for the chain in general. Only independent reporting on how LGBTQIA+ customers or the community are treated is recorded: news outlets, LGBTQIA+ media and advocacy groups. Left out: a company's own statements, posts that could not be opened to confirm, and workplace policy, which the CEI already scores. Stance follows what the source documents; mixed means it documents both harm and a corrective or supportive response. Coverage follows media attention, so a chain with no review is not evidence either way.

reviews.address: 1500 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32803 (Publix at Colonialtown)
reviews.summary: Bakery staff at the Colonialtown Publix, known locally as "the gay Publix", refused to write "Trans people deserve joy" on a cake, calling it political. Publix later apologized and offered to remake it.
reviews.quote: Last month, Yasmin Flasterstein and Dandelion Hill of Central Florida visited a Publix in the Colonialtown neighborhood of Orlando — known to locals as “the gay Publix” because of the large population of LGBTQ+ people who shop there — to buy flowers and a cake for their event.
reviews._note: The article names the neighborhood, not the street. Publix at Colonialtown (store #662, 1500 E Colonial Dr) is the only Publix there.

source.title: Florida bakery refuses to write ‘Trans’ on cake, cites Publix policy

reviews.summary: A column in which a trans employee calls Starbucks extremely LGBT-friendly, while the writer notes union allegations that Pride decorations were removed from some stores.
reviews.quote: Those claims and the allegations of the union can both be true, in the same way that Starbucks can receive a perfect score from the HRC and remove Pride decorations from certain stores.

source.title: Starbucks is not a monolith

reviews.summary: After a Hollywood, California store refused a trans woman the women's restroom, Walgreens adopted a policy across its 8,000 stores letting customers use the restroom that matches their gender identity.
reviews.quote: Drugstore chain Walgreens has adopted a new companywide policy that permits customers to use store bathrooms that align with their gender identity.

source.title: Walgreens adopts transgender-inclusive bathroom policy

reviews.summary: A pharmacist at an Oakland, California Walgreens refused a trans man's hormone refill on religious grounds. The store manager apologized and he got his medication.
reviews.quote: A transgender man in Oakland, California, claims a pharmacist at his local Walgreens refused to refill his prescribed hormone medication due to a religious objection.

source.title: Trans Man Says Walgreens Pharmacist Refused to Fill Prescription

reviews.summary: A pharmacist at a Fountain Hills, Arizona CVS refused a trans woman's hormone prescription and questioned her in front of customers. CVS apologized and said he no longer worked there.
reviews.quote: She said that he "refused to fill one of the prescriptions needed to affirm my identity" and "kept asking, loudly and in front of other CVS staff and customers, why I was given the prescriptions."

source.title: CVS apologizes for pharmacist who refused to fill transgender woman's prescription

reviews.summary: Trans activists said a Nashville IHOP refused to serve them, citing their service dog, which they called a cover for discrimination. IHOP said discrimination does not reflect its brand.
reviews.quote: A group of transgender activists accompanied by a service dog said they were denied breakfast at an IHOP (International House of Pancakes) on Monday in Tennessee.

source.title: IHOP Denied Food to Transgender Activists with Service Dog, Group Says

reviews.summary: A manager at a Los Angeles Denny's walked a trans woman out after another customer harassed her in the restroom. Denny's then said trans guests may use the restroom that matches their gender identity.
reviews.quote: The unidentified trans woman was walked out of the restaurant by a manager, calling into question the restaurant's policy on trans customers and what bathrooms they can access.

source.title: After Woman Chased Out Bathroom, Denny's Says Supports Trans Customers

reviews.summary: Women's March, the National Black Justice Coalition and others advised Black and LGBTQIA+ people to avoid Waffle House after incidents including an employee's homophobic slur at a customer in Warsaw, North Carolina.
reviews.quote: A number of organizations, including Women’s March, National Black Justice Coalition (NBJC), 100 Black Men, and Civil Rights leaders are advising black people and LGBTQIA+/same gender loving (SGL) people to avoid Waffle House restaurants following a string of incidents of racial and homophobic bias and discrimination.

source.title: Civil Rights Activists and Organizations Issue a National Advisory to Exercise Caution After High Profile Incidents Of Discriminatory Treatment at Waffle Houses

reviews.summary: After sponsoring the 2024 Nashville Pride Parade, Cracker Barrel removed its Pride web page and ended its LGBTQ employee group in 2025 following anti-"woke" backlash.
reviews.quote: The restaurant chain, already under fire for a failed rebrand, has removed its Pride page and ended an LGBTQ employee resource group.

source.title: Cracker Barrel Removes Pride Page After Anti-'Woke' Backlash

reviews.summary: Under pressure from an anti-DEI activist, Walmart left HRC's Corporate Equality Index, began reviewing its Pride funding, and said it would keep "transgender products" from being marketed to children.
reviews.quote: Walmart says it will no longer participate in the Human Rights Campaign’s Corporate Equality Index, will make changes to its diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) policies, and will monitor its marketplace to ensure “inappropriate sexual and/or transgender products” are not marketed to children

source.title: Walmart rolls back DEI & Pride funding after direct pressure from far-right extremist
